name: ship-standard
description: Acceptance and launch dimensions that grow over time.

dimensions.title: 从功能做完到真正上线
dimensions.summary: Feature-complete is not live. Classify, evidence, package, canary, observe, rollback, stop signal.

dimensions.title: 长跑容错
dimensions.summary: Read the real page or API text first. One class, one action. Never stall the whole run.

dimensions.title: 分层定位
dimensions.summary: One session, one root cause. Layered evidence. Production path, not only dev.

dimensions.title: 质量内核
dimensions.summary: Score the min of product pillars. Lock invariants. A fix users cannot install is not a fix.

dimensions.title: 主路径验收
dimensions.summary: Real topology, same version on every end, seven-step main path, then soak.

dimensions.title: 上架面
dimensions.summary: Store and brand follow the kernel. Beta is not commercial. Production guards stay on.

dimensions.title: 产品力复利
dimensions.summary: See first, make change safe, then turn capability into a contract. North star filters the quarter.

dimensions.title: 探针先行
dimensions.summary: Red test first. Done is what the gate says. Baselines and architecture locks compound.
